compact.use: simple subject/style transformations and fast iterations

standard.use: default production brief with locks, scene direction, and constraints

extended.use: complex reference-role, historical, artifact, layout, or typography tasks only

guidance: Write natural production-brief prose, not a comma-only keyword list.
Prefer visible outcomes over camera-brand fetishism; include lens/light terminology only when it changes perspective, depth, motion, or surface response.
Repeat only the highest-value locks when editing/reference fidelity is fragile.
Use short failure-focused constraints rather than a giant negative prompt.
For editing, state both what must remain unchanged and what is allowed to change.
For text-heavy layouts, quote exact text and keep hierarchy explicit.

execution.host_native: Compile prompt and pass it to the host image tool only when image generation/editing is requested.
execution.direct_api: Use scripts/generate_api.py; execution requires --execute and configured credentials.
execution.editing: Use the same semantic locks, with reference roles and preserve/change boundaries made explicit.
execution.evaluation: Evaluate the produced image independently from prompt compilation.

size.notes: Custom WIDTHxHEIGHT must be multiples of 16, aspect ratio between 1:3 and 3:1, max 3840x2160. auto is omitted from the SDK payload.

quality.notes: auto is omitted from the SDK payload.

background.notes: auto/null are omitted from the SDK payload. Official API reference notes transparent may be rejected for gpt-image-2 targets; the executor still accepts the CLI value and records it.

notes: scripts/generate_api.py and aipf.model_adapter share one normalized effective request for dry-run and SDK execution.
Only verified_model_ids are accepted by the PR1 executor; other provider/model IDs are rejected before network I/O.
Alias gpt-image-2 must not be reported as a verified dated-snapshot request solely because a default snapshot label exists in CLI/env configuration.
GPT Image models return b64_json; URL transport is recorded if present but does not count as a successful local save.
No separate adapter schema file is added; this JSON remains the sole GPT Image 2 adapter record and is checked by unit tests.

research_note: OpenAI currently lists GPT Image 2 as the state-of-the-art image generation/editing model, with flexible image sizes, high-fidelity image inputs, and a dated snapshot gpt-image-2-2026-04-21 for reproducibility. V3.2 records the model alias and snapshot separately and does not invent unsupported seed controls. PR1 executor verification re-checked official model and Images API docs on 2026-10-27 and still recognizes only gpt-image-2 and gpt-image-2-2026-04-21 as verified execution targets for this repository path.
